{{Top|leg}}
'''Mimn<nowiki>'</nowiki>yet surgery''' was the nickname given to the surgery performed by the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|medical staff]] on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It illustrated the fast, furious, and [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] pace of the work. The name itself referred to [[mimn'yet]], a questionable meat dish favored by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]].
